gen-gf-iceland-fs-rowan: Tight, blocky and a bit military: Iceland cuts every stroke to one measured depth. Rowan, a classic serif, loosens things with open curves and thick-thin strokes that feel lived in, though it isn't meant for long paragraphs.
gen-gf-itim-archivo: Itim looks like quick pen-and-paper lettering, friendly and unfussy, with ascenders that barely rise above the midline. Archivo follows with outward-opening curves and a tall x-height, so a short read goes down easily.
gen-gf-itim-fs-asap: Casual pen-and-paper lettering with short ascenders is what defines Itim. Asap, a sans with open arcs and lowercase nearly as tall as its capitals, does the sturdy work Itim leaves alone, though not for long paragraphs.
gen-gf-itim-fs-fira-sans: Itim writes its headings like casual pen strokes with low contrast, while the steady, pressure-free line of Fira Sans comes in underneath. Handwriting greets you; the sans-serif settles in for a few lines.
gen-gf-itim-fs-public-sans: Friendly handwriting leads here, Itim with its casual pen-and-paper letters and short ascenders. And Public Sans, a hefty sans with broad open counters, gives it a firm footing, though it isn't meant for long paragraphs.
gen-gf-itim-fs-supreme: Supreme reads crisp and dense, a heavy band of text whose letters look held open rather than curled shut. A longer page under Itim's handwriting would feel punchy, better for brief copy.
gen-gf-itim-general-sans: Itim's casual pen-and-paper letters, with their short climb to the ascender, set a relaxed tone up top. But General Sans, a sans-serif with a hairline-free a and a lowercase filling the line, keeps brief copy tidy.
gen-gf-itim-manrope: Itim brings casual, friendly pen-and-paper letters with ascenders that stay short. Manrope, a sans with bright open curves and a single-width line, makes that handwritten warmth easy to follow, though it isn't meant for long paragraphs.
gen-gf-itim-montserrat: Montserrat is geometric and wire-fine, with oversized e and a counters. Under Itim's casual handwriting, give it a little extra size so its slim joins stay comfortable across a short read.
gen-gf-itim-satoshi: Itim sets a casual, friendly tone with pen-and-paper letters and short ascenders. And Satoshi, with its soaring x-height and one-width strokes, can go slightly smaller without its open e closing up.
